linked_rows.title: Public provider intake and asset boundary
Task-matched conformance and reproducible benchmark evidence

disposition: CrisperWhisper non-commercial-weights verifier blocker; no source, weight, runtime, adapter, annotation or result.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the exact nyrahealth/CrisperWhisper source revision, package/archive digest and the complete MIT license and notice bundle with an independent terms review.
exact_blockers.statement: No CrisperWhisper source checkout exists at an exact 40-hex revision, and no MIT license/notice bundle is staged. The pinned note only records the GitHub URL and 'code MIT'; it records no source revision, package archive, digest or notice text. No source was downloaded, cloned or reconstructed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the exact weight model ID, revision, byte count and SHA-256, the model card and complete CC-BY-NC-4.0 terms, and a written commercial/output-use decision (or a separate negotiated commercial licence) reviewed independently.
exact_blockers.statement: No CrisperWhisper weight is present or identified exactly. The pinned note records only 'weights CC-BY-NC-4.0 on Hugging Face' and no model ID, revision, byte count, digest or model card. The non-commercial CC-BY-NC-4.0 weights cannot be a commercial SDK runtime without a separate, reviewed licence. No weight was downloaded or reconstructed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply a locked offline runtime with exact package/wheel hashes, install and import digests, single-thread deterministic settings and a clean-room offline load trace.
exact_blockers.statement: No pinned offline runtime is present. The fixed candidate environment paths are absent and no lockfile, wheel digest, import digest, deterministic thread policy or offline-load trace exists. No CrisperWhisper, torch or transformers module was imported and no model was loaded.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze rights-cleared or consented 16 kHz mono audio and an independent human verbatim reference with fillers/laughter from at least two annotators, adjudication, agreement and reviewed dataset/output-use terms.
exact_blockers.statement: No rights-cleared audio or independent verbatim reference exists. There is no audio, transcript, filler/laughter span set, second annotator, adjudication or agreement statistic, and no reviewed dataset or output-use terms. CrisperWhisper output cannot be its own gold reference.

exact_blockers.required_action: Run CrisperWhisper offline on the qualified cohort with frozen lexical, filler, laughter and boundary scorers, exact token accounting, finite-output checks and uniform-timing plus filler-stripped baselines.
exact_blockers.statement: No CrisperWhisper result was reproduced. The pinned note's `[um]`, `[uh]`, `[laughter]` tags and ~30-41 ms word boundaries are source-reported claims, not a measured result. There is no local lexical WER, filler/laughter recall, boundary error, finite-output scan or matched-token accounting.

exact_blockers.required_action: After model/data/runtime/quality gates clear, measure the exact target-device paced workload, complete or explicitly waive the Rate profile with independent review, and open a separate OFF-by-default versioned intake with exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No provider, tool, adapter or intake exists, and the task row's Rate profile is a mismatch for a verbatim annotation tool. There is no target-device timing, no preferred-speed policy and no separate commercial-licence decision. No registry, default, public ABI, shared build or CI change was made.

non_claims: No CrisperWhisper source checkout, weight, tokenizer or model card is present in this package.
No CrisperWhisper, torch, transformers or equivalent runtime is imported or executed.
No audio, transcript, filler span, laughter span or annotation is read or scored.
No lexical WER, filler/laughter recall, boundary error, finite-output, baseline or timing result is reproduced.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
Non-commercial CC-BY-NC-4.0 weights are not a runtime or rights basis.
Source-reported ~30-41 ms boundaries are not independent timing gold or a preferred speed factor.

quality_outcomes.evidence: No CrisperWhisper transcript exists and no lexical WER was reproduced.
The `[um]`/`[uh]` tag claim is source-reported; no labelled filler spans exist to score recall or precision.
The `[laughter]` claim is source-reported; no labelled laughter spans exist.
The ~30-41 ms boundary claim is source-reported; no local boundary score or matched-token accounting exists.
Only a synthetic token/boundary arithmetic control exists; no real baseline exists.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: CrisperWhisper emits transcript, tags and word boundaries, not rendered audio; no mapping or duration result exists.
No rendered waveform, F0/transient metric or listening result exists.
No playback chain, queue, fill/flush or buffering measurement exists.
No 1x or rate-change comparison exists; the tool is not a stretcher.
No cohort exists at all; no unfamiliar speech, music, silence or language coverage was tested.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, clock-drift or partial-window behavior was measured.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: Verbatim filler/laughter tags could inform a pause/filler controller, but no controller, source-timestamp policy or preservation measurement exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No preference/acceptability labels or rate-to-speed policy exists; tag recall and boundary error are not a preferred speed factor.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map output to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.
